rotation.basis: day-of-year 293 (2026-10-20), day-of-month 20; pool size 34. Two-day cycle: doy 292 (10-19) emphasized indices 11-27, so doy 293 emphasizes indices 0-10 + 28-33 (17 keywords: AI radiology, medical imaging AI, AI drug discovery clinical trial, AI pathology, ambient clinical documentation, AI scribe hospital, AI triage emergency, AI sepsis prediction, electronic health record AI, AI medical device software, SaMD regulation, hospital AI deployment, AI medical licensing exam, 의료 AI, AI 진단, AI 신약개발, AI 영상판독).
rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; yesterday's 17 (indices 11-27) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. 10-19 published NEJM AI AI-auscultation LV dysfunction (Japan), bosa BIT Computer BITMate AI EMR (KIMES Busan), SimBioSys TumorSight Risk FDA 510(k) breast MRI recurrence, BMJ review of LLM trial reporting completeness, and npj Digit Med LLM-rated depression from video diaries - so documentation/EHR, imaging-clearance and LLM-evaluation expansions are steered to different angles. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - drop unless a named disease, patient, clinician or institution is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it, do not reword. Antibiotic and vaccine queries are framed therapeutically.

plan_notes: For the librarian: (1) LEAD WITH OUTLET RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (statnews, fiercehealthcare, fiercebiotech, healthcareitnews, mobihealthnews, medcitynews, endpts, biopharmadive, healthcaredive, radiologybusiness, auntminnie, healthimaging, beckershospitalreview, medpagetoday, digitalhealth.net, nature.com Nature Medicine / npj Digital Medicine / Nature Health / Communications Medicine, ai.nejm.org, jamanetwork, bmj, thelancet Digital Health, pubs.rsna.org Radiology/Radiology:AI, fda.gov press, cms.gov newsroom, gov.uk, dailypharm, docdocdoc, medigatenews, bosa). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use the queries above to fill gaps. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-20); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword. (5) DO NOT RESUBMIT rotation.recently_published_avoid.headlines (10-19: NEJM AI AI-auscultation LVD; BITMate AI EMR; SimBioSys TumorSight Risk 510(k); BMJ LLM trial reporting review; npj LLM depression video diaries; plus 10-12..10-18 list) nor same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result. (6) Today's emphasis: radiology/imaging/pathology, AI-discovered drugs in trials, scribes/EHR/documentation, ED triage and sepsis, device-software regulation, hospital deployment results, LLM board exams, Korean medical AI; aim for spread and at least one Korean-source item. (7) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
